comparison.objective: Depress a case hub, extract a disc, reorient it upright, and insert it into a slot-loading console; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hub release, delicate edge grasping, regrasping, and slot insertion differ from hex-key fastening and iterative rotary calibration.
comparison.success_condition: Requires disc release and successful console insertion without damage; candidate requires two compliant carriage stops and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Shared insertion primitives are incidental and do not duplicate the candidate’s calibration ability.
